## Type of Change
<!-- Use one of the following prefixes for the PR title: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert -->
- [ ] `feat`: A new feature
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation only changes
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance tasks

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project style.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation.
- [ ] I have checked for "shallow clones" and ensured git health.
- [ ] I have run PHPStan level 10, PHPMD, and PHPInsights.
- [ ] PR title follows Semantic Commit format (e.g., `feat: add new user dashboard`).
